channel.title: Haste Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for Haste for Apple Silicon.

item.title: Haste 1.0.5
item.description:
Haste 1.0.5 Update

  • Interactive multi-account QIF batch import: automatically detects multiple accounts inside compound QIF files and previews registers separately instead of lumping them into a single account.
  • Filters out memorized transaction templates and non-dated budget envelopes from transaction imports.

item.title: Haste 1.0.4
item.description:
Haste 1.0.4 Update

  • Automatic account deduplication on scan: merges duplicate accounts found across rotating backup directories and log archives.
  • Full transaction deduplication and balance reconciliation across multi-file datasets.
  • Session-aware OFX parser with accurate account type classification (Checking vs Savings) and bank attribution.

item.title: Haste 1.0.3
item.description:
Haste 1.0.3 Update

  • Added native OFX & QFX parser with support for Quicken for Mac OS X bundles and statement logs (2003–2007 era).
  • Added multi-era dataset discovery in DatasetScanner (1998–2000 Win32, 2001–2002 PC, and 2003–2007 Mac OFX).
  • Multi-account batch import across all discovered financial eras.

item.title: Haste 1.0.2
item.description:
Haste 1.0.2 Update

  • Added Quicken Dataset & QDF Import Assistant: automatically detects companion QIF exports, account string tables in .QSD, and provides one-click batch import.
  • Interactive QDF to QIF conversion guidance and skeleton account generator.

item.title: Haste 1.0.1
item.description:
Haste 1.0.1 Update

  • Standard macOS app data location (~/Library/Application Support/Haste), opening empty when no data exists.
  • Refreshed app icon: gold coin on an emerald green field with stamped H monogram.
  • Unified top-level View menu combining all navigation and view options.

item.title: Haste 1.0.0
item.description:
Haste 1.0.0 Initial Release

  • Native Apple Silicon implementation and historical data format suite.
  • Full checkbook register, account reconciliation, planning & budgets, and check writing.
  • Integrated Sparkle automatic updates.
